title: Non-Stationary Covariance Functions for Spatial Data on Linear Networks
summary: We introduce a novel class of non-stationary covariance functions for random fields on linear networks that allows both the variance and the correlation range of the random field to vary spatially. The proposed covariance functions are useful to model random fields with a spatial dependence that is locally isotropic with respect to the resistance metric, a distance that reflects the topology of the network.
